scientific_integrity: Claims are conditional on the Faber–Pandharipande generating identity and are proved by exact partition valuations. Computational examples supplement but do not certify all cases. No authorship or independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: For complex one-point linear Hodge integrals, genus at least two and odd primes at least five satisfying p<=2g+1; does not classify smaller-index p-adic valuations. Closely uses Holmes 2026 partition valuation proof; possible implicit equivalence with prior work is a priority risk. Independent audit not performed.
title: Sharp prime-denominator cutoff and leading residue for one-point Hodge integrals
